resources.string: APK, APKS and XAPK (with OBB). Files are read by the shell and streamed into an install session, so no storage permission is needed. Package and version are read back from Android after every install. APKM is not supported.
unzip available: APKS and XAPK supported
unzip is not available on this phone: only plain APK files can be installed.
Delete the file after a confirmed install
Install the %1$d selected APKs as ONE app (base + splits)

%1$d file(s):
%2$s

Each one is installed in its own session and checked against Android afterwards.
Install everything in the auto folder?
Every APK, APKS and XAPK in %1$s is installed. Files confirmed installed are moved to installed/.
The file is OLDER than the installed version. Android will refuse it without a downgrade.
Copies the installed APK files to %1$s. The app is not changed.
From VOID // PURGE: cache trim, empty folders and running apps. No root.
Android trims the cache of every app itself (pm trim-caches). App data is not touched. Free space on /data is measured before and after.
Android will clear app caches to free space. Apps keep their data and logins, they only rebuild their cache.
Only folders that are empty right now. Removed with rmdir, so a folder that got files in the meantime is kept. /sdcard itself cannot be scanned; pick a folder inside it.
%1$d empty folder(s) inside %2$s will be removed. Folders that are no longer empty are kept.
Removed %1$d, kept %2$d (checked on the phone after deleting)
Parent folders that became empty show up on the next scan.

Third-party apps with a live process right now (read from ps). Stop uses am force-stop, then the process list is read again. Protected apps (this app, Shizuku, launcher, keyboard, dialer, SMS, WebView) cannot be stopped.

%1$d app(s) will be force-stopped:
%2$s

Unsaved work in them is lost. Some apps start again by themselves; that is reported.
